meta_title: Tom Barry Decor | Painter & Decorator Liverpool
meta_description: Tom Barry Decor is a painter and decorator in Liverpool offering interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wallpapering. Free quotes available.
hero_eyebrow: Trusted Local Painter & Decorator — 20+ Years Experience
hero_subhead: From fresh interior walls to full exterior repaints, Tom delivers quality finishes on time and on budget across Merseyside.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Liverpool
services_subhead: Whether you need a single room refreshed or a full house renovation, Tom handles interior redecoration, exterior painting, wallpapering, and specialist finishes.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Transform any room with expert preparation, premium paint, and meticulous finishing. We work around your schedule and keep disruption to a minimum.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's exterior with weather-resistant paint and expert application. Full prep work including cleaning and repairs included.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Professional hanging of standard and textured wallpaper, including statement feature walls. We pattern-match and ensure crisp, durable results.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Expert painting of doors, skirting boards, dado rails, and fitted furniture. We use premium finishes that resist wear and maintain colour.

services.title: Damp-Proof Decoration
services.desc: Specialist finishing over treated damp walls and new plaster. We ensure proper breathability and long-lasting, stain-free results.

services.title: Commercial & Retail Repainting
services.desc: Full contract painting for shops, offices, and warehouses. We work outside trading hours and maintain high standards throughout.

about_pullquote: I take pride in leaving every home looking better than I found it.
about_para_1: Tom Barry Decor was established over two decades ago by Tom, a painter and decorator with a reputation for reliable, high-quality work across Liverpool and Merseyside. Starting as a one-man operation, the business has grown steadily through word-of-mouth recommendations and a commitment to turning up on time, delivering honest advice, and finishing jobs properly.
about_para_2: Tom works closely with each customer to understand what they want and deliver exactly that — no shortcuts, no upselling, just skilled craftsmanship at fair prices. Many of our customers return for repeat work, and we're proud to be known as the decorator who listens, delivers, and leaves your home in spotless condition.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Tom Barry Decor

reviews.text: Tom came round to give us a quote for decorating our lounge and hallway. Very professional and gave us realistic timescales. The work was brilliant—clean, tidy, and finished on time. He's clearly very experienced and takes real pride in what he does. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael P.

reviews.text: Had our entire living room redecorated including new wallpaper. Tom was a pleasure to work with—he explained everything, was flexible around our schedule, and the attention to detail is second to none. Very fair pricing too. We'll definitely have him back.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: Exterior of our house was looking tired. Tom quoted us quickly, got the job done in five days with minimal fuss, and the finish looks fantastic. He turned up when he said he would and left the place spotless. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David C.
